name: Chichibu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chichibu city emblem in red: a ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Chichibu, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 13 March 1962; the emblem dates from 8 April 1926.

features.role: Chichibu city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
